python3 - <<'PY'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/types/checker/method_pass.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    class_info.methods.contains_key("filter")
        && class_info
            .parents
            .iter()
            .any(|parent| crate::names::php_symbol_key(parent) == "php_user_filter")'''
new='''    class_info.methods.contains_key("filter")
        && class_info
            .parent
            .as_deref()
            .is_some_and(|parent| {
                crate::names::php_symbol_key(parent.trim_start_matches('\\\\')) == "php_user_filter"
            })'''
assert s.count(old)==1
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
print("parent check fixed")
